report: Reviewed the complete completed_types claim, all four ordinary implementation entries (compile/mod.rs, observe.rs, source.rs, types.rs), and all six associated ordinary tests. No TODO or N/A entries exist. The requirements are: observations use completed body results without adding inference constraints or choosing semantic candidates; every selected source expression is represented; explicit compiler error types are allowed; absent or unresolved results fail instead of being fabricated or omitted; expected text cannot affect checking; and coercion retains both original and wrapper types. In observe.rs walk_symbol requests function.body before walking the returned immutable typed tree. source::walk enumerates the source expressions independently, and the correspondence loop emits an invalid Missing row when a unique semantic counterpart is absent; collect rejects invalid or incomplete selected rows and rejects an empty selection. These correspondence candidates are already checked nodes, not inference candidates. walk_expr reads each expr.ty, including children of NeverToAny; matching excludes coercion wrappers from the original-node candidate set and appends the wrapper separately. FrozenType::read preserves Ty::Error as <error>, maps InferVar to Missing, and complete recursively checks contained types; formatting Missing cannot invent a displayed type. CompileTest::prepare passes files, edition and markers to compilation, using only expectation presence for validation/capture; the expected strings are consulted only in run after preparation succeeds. The four associated implementation files cover these essential boundaries. Test adequacy: call_argument_types asserts all three selected path/literal/call completed types; coercion_wrapper_follows_its_source_expression asserts literal u16, original return ! and wrapper u16 in order; nested_inference_variables_are_not_completed_observations rejects an inference variable nested in a tuple while accepting bool; expectations_and_source_selections_must_agree asserts absent selections fail (as well as expectation/marker consistency); completed_types_ignore_expected_text_and_use_later_constraints prepares the same fixture with two incompatible invented expectations and asserts identical u16 output for an unsuffixed literal whose later local use constrains it; explicit_error_types_are_observed_after_checking asserts an undefined path remains a visible <error> observation with its required diagnostic. The latter fixture deliberately expects an undefined-name error from both compilers, not a diagnostic added to bless an unexpected result. All meaningful assertions are visible in their annotated bodies. Source inspection establishes the missing-correspondence and recursive failure propagation branches alongside the empty-selection and nested-inference behavioral cases. Executed successfully: cargo fmt; cargo build; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib nested_inference_variables_are_not_completed_observations; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test compile_tests call_argument_types; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test compile_tests coercion_wrapper_follows_its_source_expression; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib completed_types; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib explicit_error_types_are_observed_after_checking; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib expectations_and_source_selections_must_agree. Each focused command ran one passing test. Build emitted existing compiler warnings. No snapshot updating was used and no production behavior changed. Review restarted after the new tests and essential associations were added, and the fresh claim, association metadata and complete test set were inspected.
